# Evara Dental Clinic

> Family dental clinic in Sector 18, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Run by Dr. Kshitija P Pervi, B.D.S (MUHS), Reg No. A-44613, who treats every patient personally. Appointments by phone or WhatsApp: +91 74001 77989. The site states no prices; a written quote is given after examination.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.evaradental.in/): clinic overview, about the dentist, testimonials, gallery, FAQ, contact and booking.
- [Treatments](https://www.evaradental.in/services/): all treatments offered, with links to detailed guides.
- [Teeth cleaning](https://www.evaradental.in/services/teeth-cleaning/): scaling and polishing, aftercare, how often to repeat.
- [Teeth filling](https://www.evaradental.in/services/teeth-filling/): tooth-coloured composite fillings, longevity, sensitivity.
- [Root canal treatment](https://www.evaradental.in/services/root-canal-treatment/): what an RCT involves, visits, crown afterwards.
- [Dental implants](https://www.evaradental.in/services/dental-implants/): who is suitable, timeline, aftercare, vs bridge or denture.
